_note: CLR only. Triangular cycle with no anneal; the PERIOD grows 1 -> 2 -> 4 -> 8 epochs at epochs 32 / 64 / 128. Tests whether lengthening the cycle substitutes for annealing. Baseline for comparison: B1_noanneal (fixed 1-epoch period, no anneal) capped at 93.63%.
